entities.title: Dulmál
entities.summary: An original Icelandic team word-association party game for 4 to 8 players, each on their own phone or computer, in the same room or apart: two teams, Hraun and Jökull, each with a clue-giver who gives one word and one number, on a 5×5 board of Icelandic words.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the rules and the messages in src/shared/, the page in src/client/ and public/, the word list in data/ord.txt, the Worker and the rooms' Durable Object in worker/, and the tests in test/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker.
boundaries: Invite-only: every request needs icelander.net's sign-in with the role games:dulmal (decisions.json, invite-only), checked with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here.
The room's Durable Object is the only source of truth; the page only shows what it is sent, and the hidden key is sent to clue-givers only, and to everyone once a game is over.
Rooms are kept in the Durable Object's storage and deleted after three days without activity. Nothing else is stored: no accounts, no scores, no database.
All text the players see is Icelandic and lives in src/client/text.ts and data/ord.txt.
